jobs.name: Lapland at blue hour
jobs.scene: Snowy village lane: ordinary railway crest over a cluster of three low cranberry cabins with broad snow roofs, short fence rails, one lit decorated fir, a little cocoa booth and parcel stacks. Pine groups and layered blue hills frame a clear central track corridor.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Christmas-world scenery reference for an existing Three.js children's rollercoaster game.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are visual style, palette and camera references, not edit targets. Create a fresh landscape that could belong to the same game.
Style: match the referenced wide orthographic near-side elevated view, modest yaw and down pitch, open foreground, broad faceted polygon hills, matte untextured meshes and small friendly pastel box coaches with round eyes and alternating open parcel wagons. Snow is simple geometric roof caps, tree caps and broad ground facets. The railway is thin double rails on slender supports, sleepers, entering and leaving the frame, continuous and readable. Keep the small train's visual language. Low-sided cones, boxes, polygon rocks, simple shadows. Attractive but implementable as inexpensive batched Three.js geometry.
Important: explore background terrain and decoration only. Do not design a special track attraction: no giant loop installation, no carousel, no amusement ride, no train-interacting structure. Use a gently rolling ordinary railway. No UI, text or watermark. No realistic textures, crowds, volumetric light or fog, shiny plastic, depth of field, cinematic lens or expensive glass/reflections. Any ice reflections are only flat understated colour patches, not mirror reflections.

World palette and mood: Lavender-blue early twilight sky and faceted snowy blue hills, dark teal-green tiered firs with blue-white snow caps, compact cranberry timber cabins with warm amber windows, soft pools of peach window/lantern colour on cool snow. Sparse hanging gold stars and small strings of bulbs. Spacious cosy village, not dark midnight.
New composition: Snowy village lane: ordinary railway crest over a cluster of three low cranberry cabins with broad snow roofs, short fence rails, one lit decorated fir, a little cocoa booth and parcel stacks. Pine groups and layered blue hills frame a clear central track corridor.

jobs.name: Lapland at blue hour
jobs.scene: Forest and frozen brook: ordinary rolling track passing a lavender snow clearing; a broad irregular pale-blue frozen brook in the foreground, a small timber footbridge well away from the railway, snow-capped fir groups, two distant glowing cabins, one lamp beside a wooden sled carrying presents. Maintain open space.
